name: Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares - § 91 - Am 37
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 55d. Welcomes the goals of the DigitalJustice@2030 strategy to speed up and modernise justice systems, increase access to justice, enhance cross-border judicial cooperation, leverage AI and digital tools, promote digital legal data access, and standardise and share tools across Member States;
